meta.reliability_tax_formula: SPEC §24.4 locked 5-component formula: (annualized_new_gas_capex + new_gas_FOM + existing_gas_FOM_carried + priced_VRE_curtailment + annualized_VRE_storage_overbuild_capex) ÷ cumulative_demand_MWh_2025_2050. Gross of any capacity-market netting.

anchors.p3: Commit to clean firm in 2025 (lowest reliability tax)
anchors.p2a: Delay then pivot at pivot_year (new-gas stranding accumulates)
anchors.p1a: Never commit — 2050 upper bound (max new-gas + max residual gap)

meta.interpolation_method: Linear between P3 (2025), P2a (pivot_year), P1a (2050). Per-commit-year optimizer runs do not exist in the sweep.

right_panel.note: Stacked decomposition of the 5-component reliability tax.
